pages.text: $(thing)Superacids$()$(br2)Acids a million million times stronger than sulfuric - strong enough to protonate almost anything.

$(thing)Insight$(): 50$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Electrochemistry, High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Electride Crystal.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Find the Hammett acidity H0 of an acid in which the indicator (pK of BH+ = -10.1) is 100 times more protonated than not.
